minTokens.description: clone window size in normalized tokens; lower = more sensitive

threshold.description: max allowed duplicated-lines percent across the scanned tree; 0 disables failing (report only). A RATIO: adding a large clean file lowers it without removing a clone, so set maxDuplicatedLines too, or keep a baseline

maxDuplicatedLines.description: absolute ceiling on total duplicated lines (unset by default); immune to ratio dilution by large clean files

ignore.description: globs relative to the scan root for framework-idiomatic declarative files (e.g. collections/**); their repetition is shape, not logic

includeTests.description: include *.test.*/*.spec.* files in the clone scan; catches copy-pasted test scaffolding, but table-driven tests and intentional fixture similarity add noise

maxFileLines.description: files over this many lines are flagged; a file over budget is decomposed by responsibility, never exempted per file

maxFunctionLines.description: functions/methods over this many lines are flagged

maxClassMethods.description: classes with more public methods are flagged

maxExportsPerFile.description: declared exports per file (re-exports belong to barrels and are not counted); a junk drawer is a junk drawer even under the line budget

softFactor.description: fraction of the hard cap at which a finding starts printing a soft-band note (exit 0). Pressure without a cliff

maxExceptions.description: per-repo cap on `// anti-slop: <limit> <value> — <reason>` declarations; more than this is a pattern, not an exception

ignorePaths.description: globs (scan-root- or repo-relative) for files exempt from size budgets
globs for files exempt from the docs gate and excluded from the component index

ignoreExports.description: export names that are framework configuration, not shared surface (Next.js segment config is auto-defaulted when next.config.* exists)

encoding.description: Encoding guard tuning. Build output (dist, dist-electron, build, .output, .svelte-kit, .nuxt, release, _site, ...) is always skipped; use ignorePaths for repo-specific generated directories.

ignorePaths.description: globs (scan-root- or repo-relative) exempt from the encoding gate; printed on every run like every other exemption

review.description: Trigger for optional independent review (review-scope.mjs). Advice only - the review itself is the human's decision.

enabled.description: Global switch for the optional reviewer. false = the same as uninstalling it for this repo: review-scope prints [review] disabled and no cadence is offered. Set at install time (or --no-reviewer) for teams with their own review system.

maxFiles.description: changed files at or above which review is proposed

maxLines.description: added+deleted lines at or above which review is proposed

riskPaths.description: globs that warrant review regardless of size, e.g. src/**/access/**, src/**/payments/**, **/migrations/**, .github/workflows/**

autonomy.description: ask: propose /review and wait for the human. auto: run it at the cadence agreed for the batch (autopilot) without asking again

scan.description: Framework presets write this section: it retargets every gate at the preset's language.

extensions.description: File extensions every gate scans, e.g. [".cpp", ".h"] for JUCE. Clone detection is near-universal; the modularity brace-matcher works for C-family; the docs/import gates parse JS/TS only and print a warning when they are inert.

classLiterals.description: Design-system drift: counts normalised className literals (whitespace-split, sorted, interpolations stripped) and flags ones repeated across components - the skeleton the 50-token clone window cannot see.

minOccurrences.description: repetitions before a literal is flagged; raising it to pass is the lazy fix

allow.description: globs for modules that legitimately own a literal (e.g. components/ui/**); printed like every other exemption

deny.description: dependency-direction rules: a file matching `from` importing a file matching `forbid` is a violation. Never baselined.
